title: Flooring Calculator
description: Estimate flooring material with waste allowance: boxes needed, total area and cost for any room.
keywords: how much flooring do i need
howto: Enter the room length and width in feet.
Set the waste percentage (10% is standard, 15% for diagonal layouts).
Enter your box coverage and optional price per box to get boxes and cost.

faqs.a: Cuts around edges, doorways and closets consume material, and you need spare planks or tiles for future repairs. 10% covers most straight layouts.

faqs.q: Where do I find box coverage?
faqs.a: It is printed on the flooring box as "coverage" or "sq ft per carton", commonly 15-25 sq ft.

faqs.q: Should I measure in feet or meters?
faqs.a: This tool uses feet. Multiply meters by 3.281 to convert before entering.
